spans.s: द्रौण, अस्, ई, अम्, containing a droṇa.

द्रौणायन, अस्, m. or द्रौणायनि, इस्, m. a
patronymic of Aśvatthāman son of Droṇa.

द्रौणि, इस्, m. a patronymic of Aśvatthāman; of
Vyāsa in a future Dvāpara.

द्रौणी, f. (a wrong form for द्रोणी), a trough,
tub, &c.

द्रौणिक, अस्, ई, अम्, containing a droṇa; sown
with a droṇa of grain (as a field); (ई), f. a vessel
holding a droṇa by measure.

द्रौघण द्रौघण, अस्, ई, अम्, an adj. formed
fr. द्रु-घण, q. v.

द्रौपद द्रौपद, अस्, m. (fr. द्रु-पद), in
द्रौपदादित्य, a form of the Sun; (ई), f. a patro-
nymic of Kṛṣṇā, wife of the Pāṇḍu princes.
—द्रौ-
पदि-ज, अस्, m. (for द्रौपदी-ज), a son of Draupadī.
—द्रौपदी-प्रमाथ, अस्, m. the forcible abduc-
[]
tion of Draupadī; [cf. द्रौपदी-हरण.]
—द्रौ-
पदी-वस्त्राहरण (˚र-आह्˚), अम्, n. ‘the seizure
of Draupadī's garments,’ N. of a poem by an unknown
author on the story told in Sabhā-p. 2186.
—द्रौ-
पदी-हरण, अम्, n. ‘forcible abduction of Draupadī,’
N. of a section of the Mahā-bh. Vana-p. 15492.

द्रौपदेय, अस्, m. a patronymic of any of the
five sons of the five Pāṇḍu princes, viz. of Prati-
vindhya, son of Yudhi-ṣṭhira; of Suta-soma, son of
Bhīma; of Śruta-kīrtti or Śruta-karman, son of
Arjuna; of Śatānīka, son of Nakula; and of Śruta-
sena, son of Saha-deva.

द्रौह्य द्रौह्य, अस्, m. (fr. द्रुह्य), a patro-
nymic from Druhya.
द्रौह्यव, अस्, m. a patronymic from Druhyu.
